name: Nino Roche
source: A fiery young woman with passion for the outer world matched only by her anger toward the Builder. Though she and Fel were inseparable all throughout high school, they seem to have drifted apart years ago. Following a brief stint at the Messenger, Nino went on to university. Why, then, was she last seen inside the Hollow Temple?
